card.name: Organization names before people roles
card.fires_on: Organization or program names and linking words just before a person-role noun such as ambassador, champion, co-founder or professional. Seen in general web text about notable people and campaigns.

modes.label: Organization name
modes.description: Part of a company or charity name that is followed by a title for a person.
modes.example: the<< Microsoft>> co-founder and chairman said.

modes.label: Award or title phrase
modes.description: A word inside a title like Most Valuable Professional or Climate Champions.
modes.example: a Microsoft Most Valuable<< Professional>> for his work with Windows 20

modes.label: Linking word
modes.description: A small word such as at, of or such that leads into a group or example.
modes.example: Matthew is a youth blogger<< at>> Greenpeace, USA.

card.writes: It pushes toward words for notable people and roles, such as entrepreneur, champion, artist and leader.
card.plain: It fires where a group name or title is about to be followed by a word for a person's role, like ambassador or champion.
